method: both arms through the router at 127.0.0.1:8080, model name asserted as the only differing payload key
finding: Fine-tuning achieved what it was trained for - bare JSON without markdown fences, 0/6 to 6/6 - and cost numeric fidelity, 5/6 to 0/6. Both models produce schema-valid JSON, so the previously reported 0.0% schema accuracy for the base arm was an artefact of both backends resolving to one file, not a property of the base model.
